title: Sheafification comparison from an etale cover of representable generators
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and work on a big fppf site $\mathcal C=(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site]. Choose the value universe to contain the objects and morphisms of this site. Let $U,U'$ be its objects and $g:U'\to U$ an etale $S$-morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Write $h_U(T)=\operatorname{Hom}_S(T,U)$ and $h_{U'}(T)=\operatorname{Hom}_S(T,U')$, with restrictions by precomposition, and $h_g:h_{U'}\to h_U$ for postcomposition by $g$. Let $P,P'$ be presheaves of sets on $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $v:P'\to P$ be a natural transformation injective on sections over every object, and let $q:h_U\to P$ and $q':h_{U'}\to P'$ be natural transformations surjective on sections over every object, satisfying $v q'=q h_g$. Let $\eta:P\to F$ and $\eta':P'\to F'$ be chosen sheafifications [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. There is a unique sheaf morphism $\alpha:F'\to F$ satisfying $\alpha\eta'=\eta v$, and $\alpha_T$ is injective for every $T$. If $g$ is surjective on underlying scheme points, the following local lifting assertion holds: for every $T$ and $z\in F(T)$ there are an fppf covering $\{f_i:T_i\to T\}$ and maps $a_i:T_i\to U$ with $z|_{T_i}=\eta(q(a_i))$. For $W_i=T_i\times_{a_i,U,g}U'$ [def-pc-fibre-product] and projections $p_i:W_i\to T_i$, $b_i:W_i\to U'$, each singleton $\{p_i\}$ is an etale surjective, hence fppf, covering, $\{f_i p_i:W_i\to T\}$ is an fppf covering, and $\alpha(\eta'(q'(b_i)))=z|_{W_i}$. These sections $\eta'(q'(b_i))$ agree on pairwise overlaps and have a unique glued section $\widetilde z\in F'(T)$ with $\alpha(\widetilde z)=z$. The assignment $z\mapsto\widetilde z$ is independent of the covering and representatives and is natural in $T$; it is inverse to $\alpha$, so $\alpha$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 045Z (lemma-quotient-pre-equivalence-relation-restrict), proof of injectivity and covering-surjectivity, abstracted to compatible representable generators of arbitrary presheaves.

proof.text: By the universal property [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], identify each chosen sheafification with the canonical sheafification: construct maps in both directions and prove both inverse identities by uniqueness. By [lem-weil-pbc-large-set-sheafification], the canonical units, and therefore the chosen units, are locally injective and locally surjective in the value universe Type (max (u+1) v).

source.place: Tags 00WH and 00WK; universal property and local bijectivity of the sheafification unit.

proof.text: Apply the universal property of the chosen unit eta-prime to v followed by eta, obtaining the unique comparison alpha. Sectionwise injectivity of v implies local injectivity. The composite v followed by eta is locally injective. Mathlib Presheaf.comp_isLocallyInjective_iff cancels the locally bijective eta-prime from eta-prime followed by alpha. Thus alpha is locally injective, and Sheaf.isLocallyInjective_iff_injective gives sectionwise injectivity, without assuming g surjective.

source.place: Tag 045Z, injectivity paragraph, using the abstract local-injectivity API for the same sheafification argument.

proof.text: For any z in F(T), local surjectivity of eta makes its image sieve covering. The fppf topology over S equals the topology generated by the comap of fppfPrecoverage along Over.forget S. The precoverage criterion extracts an actual fppf covering presieve contained in this image sieve. Present it as an indexed family and raise its index universe with ULift, which leaves its covering presieve unchanged. On each arrow choose a preimage t_i of the restriction of z, then use sectionwise surjectivity of q to obtain a_i with q(a_i)=t_i. This proves the stated local-representative equation.

source.place: Tag 00WK, local representatives; the precoverage presentation of the covering sieve.

proof.text: Assume g is surjective. Apply the pullback-preserving forgetful functor from Over S to the chosen pullback squares [def-pc-fibre-product]. Stability of etaleness and surjectivity under base change [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-base-change] gives both properties for every first projection. Etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism] are flat and locally of finite presentation, so each projection is a singleton fppf covering [def-pc-fppf-site]. For the composite family, every point lifts through an original covering arrow and then through the surjective first projection. Each composite is flat and locally of finite presentation by composition. Hence the composite family is an actual fppf covering.

source.place: Tag 021O, covering base change and composition; Morphisms Tags 02GO and 01S1.

proof.text: On every pullback W_i, evaluate the comparison equation eta-prime followed by alpha = v followed by eta and hcompat at the second projection. The pullback equation replaces b_i followed by g with p_i followed by a_i. Naturality of q followed by eta and the representative equation give alpha(eta-prime(q-prime(b_i))) = z restricted to W_i. Thus the covering of the previous step lies in the image sieve of alpha. This proves local surjectivity of alpha. Together with its local injectivity, Mathlib Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso applies the sheaf condition [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] to glue the local preimages and proves alpha is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 045Z, covering-surjectivity paragraph; explicit local lifts and the sheaf local-bijection criterion.

proof.text: Let beta be the inverse of alpha. For any two restrictions of the specified local lifts with equal composite arrows to T, naturality and the preceding image formula give equal alpha-images; sectionwise injectivity gives their equality. The same argument proves that beta_T(z) restricts to every specified local lift. Its alpha-image is z by the inverse identity. Any other such section with image z equals beta_T(z) by injectivity, proving the displayed unique gluing. Both inverse identities hold by construction; if alpha_T(x)=z then injectivity also gives beta_T(z)=x. This establishes independence of all representatives and covers, with naturality already built into beta.

source.place: Tag 045Z, final isomorphism assertion; choice independence and unique gluing expanded.

proof_origin.place: Tag 045Z, compatible-generator local lifting argument; Sites Tags 00WH, 00WK and 00WM, and Topologies Tag 021O. The Lean proof uses the proved larger-universe local-bijection theorem and Mathlib local-bijection APIs instead of an explicit common-refinement calculation. All local pullback lifts, covering assertions, overlap equalities, glued-section properties and inverse identities are proved.

Source read: Stacks groupoids.tex Tag 045Z (l.3819-3858; injectivity from local representatives plus the sheaf condition, the iso from a covering) and 02VH (l.3860-3915; lifting along a covering). The agent-written abstraction to a sectionwise-injective v with surjective generators q, q' is faithful. All 8 cited statements read; the following steps were checked against them. S1: the universal property of def-weil-pbc-sheafification gives a unique alpha. S2: sections-local, the common refinement and the local-equality clause for P, then v injective, axiom (ii) and sheaf uniqueness give injectivity, without assuming the units injective. S3: local representatives plus q surjective give the a_i. S4: lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-base-change on the singleton {g} gives p_i etale and surjective, hence flat and lfp, so {p_i} is fppf; the composite {f_i p_i} is a covering by axiom (ii); {g} is an fppf covering, so W_i lies in the site by (iii). S5: the chain alpha(eta' q' b_i) = eta v q' b_i = eta q(g b_i) = eta q(a_i p_i) = z|W_i is correct; the overlaps agree by S2; F' glues and F's uniqueness gives alpha(z~) = z. S6: independence of choices, naturality and both inverse equations follow by injectivity. Edge cases: g = id; empty T or covering; g a non-surjective open immersion (injectivity only, as in 045Z); non-separated P, P'. The hypothesis that q' is surjective is unused but kept, which is not a weakening. Duplicate scan: the nearest nodes are locally-bijective-iso (abelian, abstract), the relation-coequalizer node and the sheafify-action nodes; none is the same statement. Accepted tool_uses: sk-thm-p1 sections-local and common-refinement, both generic site facts. No SGA cited. No changes.

φ : F ⟶ G, η ≫ φ.hom = θ) (hη' : ∀ (G : Sheaf (fppfTopology.over S) (Type (max (u + 1) v))) (θ : P' ⟶ G.obj), ∃! φ : F' ⟶ G, η' ≫ φ.hom = θ) : ∃ α : F' ⟶ F, η' ≫ α.hom = vmap ≫ η ∧ (∀ α' : F' ⟶ F, η' ≫ α'.hom = vmap ≫ η → α' = α) ∧ (∀ T : Over S, Function.Injective (α.hom.app (op T))) ∧ (Surjective g.left → (∀ (T : Over S) (z : F.obj.obj (op T)), (∃ (I : Type (max (u + 1) v)) (V : I → Over S) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ T) (a : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U), Presieve.ofArrows (fun i ↦ (V i).left) (fun i ↦ (f i).left) ∈ fppfPrecoverage T.left ∧ ∀ i, F.obj.map (f i).op z = η.app (op (V i)) (q.app (op (V i)) (ULift.up (a i)))) ∧ (∀ (I : Type (max (u + 1) v)) (V : I → Over S) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ T) (a : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U), Presieve.ofArrows (fun i ↦ (V i).left) (fun i ↦ (f i).left) ∈ fppfPrecoverage T.left → (∀ i, F.obj.map (f i).op z = η.app (op (V i)) (q.app (op (V i)) (ULift.up (a i)))) → (∀ i, Etale (pullback.fst (a i) g).left ∧ Surjective (pullback.fst (a i) g).left ∧ Presieve.singleton (pullback.fst (a i) g).left ∈ fppfPrecoverage (V i).left) ∧ Presieve.ofArrows (fun i ↦ (pullback (a i) g).left) (fun i ↦ ((pullback.fst (a i) g) ≫ f i).left) ∈ fppfPrecoverage T.left ∧ (∀ i, α.hom.app (op (pullback (a i) g)) (η'.app (op (pullback (a i) g)) (q'.app (op (pullback (a i) g)) (ULift.up (pullback.snd (a i) g)))) = F.obj.map ((pullback.fst (a i) g) ≫ f i).op z) ∧ (∀ (i j : I) (Z : Over S) (r : Z ⟶ pullback (a i) g) (s : Z ⟶ pullback (a j) g), r ≫ pullback.fst (a i) g ≫ f i = s ≫ pullback.fst (a j) g ≫ f j → F'.obj.map r.op (η'.app (op (pullback (a i) g)) (q'.app (op (pullback (a i) g)) (ULift.up (pullback.snd (a i) g)))) = F'.obj.map s.op (η'.app (op (pullback (a j) g)) (q'.app (op (pullback (a j) g)) (ULift.up (pullback.snd (a j) g))))) ∧ ∃! x : F'.obj.obj (op T), (∀ i, F'.obj.map ((pullback.fst (a i) g) ≫ f i).op x = η'.app (op (pullback (a i) g)) (q'.app (op (pullback (a i) g)) (ULift.up (pullback.snd (a i) g)))) ∧ α.hom.app (op T) x = z)) ∧ (∃ β : F ⟶ F', β ≫ α = 𝟙 F ∧ α ≫ β = 𝟙 F' ∧ ∀ (T : Over S) (z : F.obj.obj (op T)) (x : F'.obj.obj (op T)), α.hom.app (op T) x = z → β.hom.app (op T) z = x) ∧ IsIso α)
